card.name: Opening parenthesis before a reference or note
card.fires_on: Mostly an opening parenthesis or small linking word such as 'by' or 'See' right after a term, where a cross-reference, citation or aside follows. Also fires on 'ESIS' in the all-caps MUTAGENESIS of boxed-warning headings.

modes.label: Parenthesis before an aside
modes.description: An open bracket after a word or unit, introducing a note, comparison or cross-reference.

modes.label: Linking word before a source
modes.description: 'by' or 'See' placed where a credit or table reference follows.

modes.label: End of MUTAGENESIS
modes.description: The ending of the all-caps word MUTAGENESIS in a boxed warning title.
modes.example: FETAL TOXICITY, MUTAGEN<<ESIS>> AND CARCINOGENESIS Hemat

card.plain: It fires on small punctuation or linking words that lead into a reference or side note, plus the ending of MUTAGENESIS in warning headings.
